title: Backtest: US insider-buying clusters ($300M-$10B, 2021-2024) showed no excess return vs size-matched controls
body: Own backtest (run 2026-11-20). Full population of Form 4 purchases from SEC Insider Transactions Data Sets; rule = >=2 distinct directors/officers buying (code P, not 10b5-1, price>=$1, common stock) within 30 days; dated on the filing day the 2nd buy became public, entry next trading day; one event per issuer per 365 days; mcap $300M-$10B (cover-page shares x insider price); SPACs/funds dropped, biotech separate. 849 usable non-biotech events (signals 2021-2024). Versus 5 size-matched random controls per event on the same date: 12m mean excess 0.0% (95% month-clustered bootstrap CI -4.8% to +5.0%), median -3.9%, hit rate 44.9%; 6m -0.3% (CI -3.3% to +2.6%). Versus IWM +1.7% 12m mean (CI -2.7% to +6.4%) but controls also beat IWM by +1.7%, so that is a size/survivor effect; versus SPY -7.9%. No subset was clean: $300M-$1B +4.8% 12m (CI -2.2 to +12.3), banks +4.0% at 6m (CI -2.5 to +10.0), >=3 insiders and CEO/CFO buys were worse, 2021 signals only year significantly positive (+6.3%). Survivorship: ~19% of eligible events lacked Yahoo data (SEC audit of 189: 162 acquired, 23 bankrupt); generous bound adds only ~+2%/yr. Lesson: the plain public cluster rule is not a standalone edge in this period; CMP-sized (~10%/yr) effect not reproduced without the opportunistic/routine filter. Use as a research-queue trigger only.

data.lesson: Public cluster screen = no standalone edge; at most a reason to research. Next test must pre-register opportunistic-only (CMP) + buy-size filter out of sample.

title: Tested rule: buy US $300M-$10B stocks after >=2 insiders make open-market purchases within 30 days (hold 6-12m)
body: Rule as tested (2026-11-20 backtest, signals 2021-2024). Trigger: Form 4 code P purchases of common stock by >=2 distinct directors or officers with trade dates within 30 days; exclude 10b5-1 trades (checkbox or footnote), 10%-owner-only filers, option exercises/grants, price < $1, preferred/warrants/units. Signal date = filing date of the second insider's Form 4 (no look-ahead); enter at next trading-day close; one signal per issuer per 365 days. Universe: market cap $300M-$10B, ex SPACs/funds, listed >= 180 days; biotech/pharma handled separately (binary events). Hold 6 or 12 months; compare with 5 random same-size firms on the same date and with IWM. Result: no reliable excess return vs matched controls (12m mean 0.0%, CI -4.8% to +5.0%, hit 44.9%; see insight:bt-us-insider-clusters-2021-2024). Status: REJECTED as a standalone strategy for 2021-2024; keep only as a research-queue trigger. Untested refinements worth a pre-registered out-of-sample test: Cohen-Malloy-Pomorski opportunistic-only buyers (no same-month trade in prior 3 years), buy size >= 10% of the insider's existing stake, sub-$1B or bank issuers, poorly covered names; analogous test on India SEBI PIT Reg 7 disclosures.

data.trigger: >=2 distinct D/O open-market buys (code P) within 30 days, non-10b5-1
data.entry: next trading day after 2nd insider's filing date
data.universe: US $300M-$10B, ex SPAC/fund, listed >=180d, biotech separate
data.next_test: CMP opportunistic filter + buy-size filter, build 2017-2020, test 2021-2024
